# 나이트라이프 코리아 (Nightlife Korea)

> 한국 전국 나이트, 클럽, 라운지 130곳의 상세 정보를 제공하는 가이드 사이트

## About
Korean nightlife venue directory covering 130 nights, clubs, and lounges
across major cities including Gangnam, Busan, Daegu, Incheon, Daejeon,
Gwangju, and Jeju. Content is AI-generated and quality-checked.

## Content Per Venue Page
- Atmosphere description
- Music genre and style
- Safety and etiquette guide
- 5-scene storytelling narrative
- Visit timeline with recommended schedule
- First-visit checklist (7 items)
- Custom course planner
- FAQ (8 questions and answers)
- Location and transportation info
- Nightlife type comparison table
- Personality quiz
- Related venues

## Site Structure
- / — Homepage with search and filtering
- /night/{region}/{venue}/ — Night venue detail pages
- /club/{region}/{venue}/ — Club venue detail pages
- /lounge/{region}/{venue}/ — Lounge venue detail pages
- /nights/ — Night venue listing
- /clubs/ — Club venue listing
- /lounges/ — Lounge venue listing
- /region/{region}/ — Regional hub pages
- /guides/ — Nightlife guides
- /about/ — About this site
- /editorial-policy/ — Editorial and content policy

## Structured Data (JSON-LD)
Each venue page includes:
- schema.org/WebPage (with dateModified, speakable)
- schema.org/NightClub (name, description, address, geo)
- schema.org/FAQPage (8 Q&A pairs)
- schema.org/BreadcrumbList

Homepage includes:
- schema.org/WebSite (with SearchAction)
- schema.org/ItemList (130 venues)
